title: Azagaia funeral procession in Maputo, followed by police obstruction and tear gas
reason: Excluded from protest candidates on inspected evidence because it is reported as a funeral procession/tribute and the evidence does not establish a demand directed at the Mozambican government or its policy. Police force alone does not establish protester demand.
notes: CDD says thousands attended the funeral procession and that police blocked a route and used tear gas. Treat it as a relevant lead, not an eligible protest, unless independent evidence establishes a state-directed demand.

title: Planned Azagaia homage march cancelled before occurrence in Pemba
reason: ACLED search-rendered report says police opposed the planned march in Cabo Delgado, including this named city, and the plans were cancelled. The search result therefore supports non-occurrence of this planned action at this site; it does not establish that no other protest occurred there.
notes: Search-only exclusion for this planned Azagaia march; no body opened.
